expectations.evidence: The rewrite adds "> /etc/billing/tls/new.pem" as a shell redirect (original only says output should be saved there), "Then restart the drain and investigate the issue" (invented rollback step), and a rollback curl check, plus "Allow up to 2 minutes for existing jobs to complete" (embellishes the drain claim).
Step 2 "sudo cp /etc/billing/tls/current.pem /etc/billing/tls/previous.pem" precedes the step 4 swap, and Rollback does "cp previous.pem current.pem" then "systemctl restart billing-worker".
The 2024 Vault move history is dropped, the Overview is two short sentences, and the steps contain only brief one-line notes.
Prerequisites (VPN, role, not month-end) come before the steps, each numbered step has one action, and backup (step 2) precedes the swap (step 4) with no forward dependencies.
